WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state
 FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21')
SELECT status, fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) drl, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vatmis
FROM w GROUP BY ALL

WITH s AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, count(*) n,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datediff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
 GROUP BY ALL),
r AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(rl.refund_net) ret_net, count(*) rn
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=rl.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=rl.return_date
 WHERE st.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.*, r.ret_net, r.rn FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(r.returns_net) rt, sum(r.net_sales) ns, sum(r.receipts) rc
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT rl.return_line_id) dr, count(DISTINCT rl.sales_line_id) ds, sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='ST' OR f.channel_id=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) stlines, sum(rl.refund_net) 
FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=rl.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=rl.return_date LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id
WHERE st.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) utc_net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE)
WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, min(f.sale_ts_utc), max(f.sale_ts_utc)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3))
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS web_net_sales
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
